description: This file defines an API client for a Flutter application, including HTTP request methods (GET, POST), error handling with ApiException, and environment configuration via Env. It provides tools for network communication with a RESTful backend.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: An exception class for handling API errors, carrying HTTP status, message, and optional cause.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client for making HTTP requests to a REST API, supporting GET and POST with JSON handling, optional authorization token, and environment-based base URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path, with optional query parameters and headers, and returns the parsed response.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body to the specified path, with optional headers and query parameters, returning the parsed response.
